description: SessionStart: a one-line pointer to agents-with-taste in repos with UI code and in empty folders, silent in backend-only repos and where the taste gate is declined. PostToolUse[Edit|Write], once per session: runs impeccable's detector on the first UI file edited and names the guide that fits; in a project where impeccable's own auto-check isn't wired and the gate is undecided, it starts the one-question setup instead. Hooks only inject context - loading the skill stays Claude's call.
